dashboardDesc: Overview of the penetration of mobile and fixed subscriptions (narrow and broadband).

disagregation.label: Active mobile-broadband subscriptions
disagregation.codeDesc: Refers to the sum of active handset-based and computer-based (USB/dongles) mobile-broadband subscriptions that allow access to the Internet, divided by population and multiplied by 100

disagregation.label: Fixed-telephone subscriptions
disagregation.codeDesc: Refers to the sum of all active analogue fixed-telephone lines, voice-over-IP (VoIP) subscriptions, fixed wireless local loop (WLL) subscriptions, ISDN voice-channel equivalents, fixed public payphones and satellite-based subscriptions provided to fixed locations that allow for a voice communication divided by population and multiplied by 100

disagregation.label: Mobile-cellular subscriptions
disagregation.codeDesc: Refers to the number of subscriptions to a public mobile-telephone service that provide access to the public switched telephone network (PSTN) using cellular technology. It includes the number of postpaid subscriptions and the number of active prepaid accounts, divided by population and multiplied by 100

dashboardCodes.collection: Population coverage, by mobile network technology

components.label: At least 2G
components.codeDesc: Refers to the percentage of inhabitants within range of a mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers or users

components.label: At least 3G
components.codeDesc: Refers to the percentage of inhabitants that are within range of at least a 3G mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers

components.label: At least LTE/WiMAX
components.codeDesc: Refers to the percentage of inhabitants that are within range of at least a 4G/ LTE mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers

components.label: At least 5G
components.codeDesc: Refers to the percentage of inhabitants that are within range of at least a 5G mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers

dashboardCodes.label: Fixed-broadband subscriptions
dashboardCodes.codeDesc: Refers to fixed subscriptions to high-speed access to the public Internet (a TCP/IP connection), at downstream speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s divided by population and multiplied by 100
